meta.requirement: Explore Starfell Lake (30%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Hunter's Share
start.text:
''Smoke thins above a rough camp on the eastern shore. Wooden racks lean toward the water, hung with strips of meat still darkening in the breeze. A man in a Springvale hunting cloak stands between the racks and the scrub, bow half-drawn.''

''Three Hilichurls edge closer through the reeds, eyes on the meat, not on him.''

Cole: ''without looking away'' Stay back from the racks. I mean it.

''One Hilichurl laughs that broken-throat laugh and takes another step. Cole's bowstring creaks.''

Cole: ''spotting you'' Traveller. Either help me keep these thieves off my catch, or stand somewhere they cannot smell you. I am out of patience and nearly out of arrows.

What_happened_here_.text:
Cole: ''jaw tight'' Good hunt. Too good. I took more game than I meant to before the light started going. Hung what I could to dry. Figured I could haul it to Springvale in two trips.

''He jerks his chin at the Hilichurls.''

Cole: They smelled it before I finished the first string. Now I cannot leave, and I cannot carry the whole load while they circle. ''beat'' Help me drive them off. After that, we talk about the surplus.

I_will_clear_them_out.text:
''Cole falls back behind the nearest rack, bow up. The Hilichurls surge toward the hanging meat, clubs raised, already arguing over who eats first.''

''The shore is theirs unless you take it back.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Drive the Hilichurls away from Cole's drying racks at Starfell Lake

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Fight the Hilichurls. Defeat 3 [[Hilichurl]]s

Fight_the_Hilichurls.text:
''The last Hilichurl breaks and runs into the reeds. Cole lowers his bow and checks the racks with a hunter's quick count: strips still hanging, none torn down.''

Cole: ''exhales'' Still here. Good.

''He glances at the sky, then at the stacked wraps of butchered game by his pack.''

Cole: I can carry what Springvale needs before dark. The rest will draw every scavenger from here to the Whispering Woods if I leave it. ''looks at you'' You fought for it. You take a share.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Talk to Cole at his shore camp

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Cole

____The_Hunter_s_Share__Hunter_s_Share_T.title: Hunter's Share Taken
____The_Hunter_s_Share__Hunter_s_Share_T.text:
''Cole wraps fifteen cuts of Raw Meat in clean cloth and presses the bundle into your hands. Heavy. Cold. Honest weight.''

Cole: Cook it. Trade it. Feed someone who needs it. Just do not leave it for the birds.

''He slings his lighter pack, checks the remaining racks one last time, and starts the path toward Springvale.''

Cole: Safe roads, traveller. And thanks. A full rack is only useful if someone lives to eat from it.
